title: Gemini 3.1 Website Builder
content: Hey, so Gemini 3.1 is like really good at making websites. And I initially thought that this was just going to be some hype BS because I saw a bunch of posts on Twitter... The quality here is honestly unreal. And I was not expecting this... The prompt is literally: act as a worldclass senior creative technologist and lead front-end engineer. The objective is to architect a highfidelity cinematic 1:1 pixel perfect landing page... Aesthetic identities: high-end organic tech clinical boutique... it uses vit, react, tailwind CSS... Model is really good... you can launch on Netlify or Vercel completely free.
